title: 固定搭配接 doing

examples.en: I spent two hours doing my homework.
We are looking forward to seeing you.

guess.question: look forward to 里的 to 是介词还是不定式的标志？

options.text: 是介词，所以后面要接 doing
options.feedback: 对！这里的 to 是介词，to see you 是错的，要说 seeing you。

options.text: 是不定式标志，后面接动词原形
options.feedback: 不对——look forward to 的 to 是介词，跟 want to do 的 to 不是一回事。
不对——只能接 doing，接原形就是错的。

rule.rule: spend…(in) doing / be busy doing / look forward to doing / be used to doing / give up doing 等固定搭配接 doing
rule.formula: spend + 时间/钱 + (in) doing　be busy (in) doing　look forward to + doing　be used to + doing

anchors.en: She spent an hour reading the book.
anchors.zh: 她花了一小时读这本书。

anchors.en: They are looking forward to meeting you.

trap.wrong: I'm looking forward to see you soon.
trap.right: I'm looking forward to seeing you soon.
trap.why: look forward to 的 to 是介词，后面接 doing。

guess_callback: 你刚才选的是 A——这几个搭配里的 to 都是介词：look forward to / be used to / pay attention to。

check.stem: He spent two hours ____ (finish) the work.
We are looking forward to ____ (see) you again.

options.distractor: 这里的 to 是介词，不能接原形
to 已经在了，不能重复

options.text: The farmers are busy getting in the crops.
The farmers are busy to get in the crops.
The farmers are busy get in the crops.
The farmers are busy got in the crops.
